story_review.one_viewing_summary: Planned chain on the measured clock, not observed. The camera's display pans the land and smoke rises in it. The view pulls back to the tower. Sixteen rings light and 16 installed stamps, and 56 planned pins. The display finds the same fire and flags it. The alert card leaves the display and lands on the cab's dash phone. The dash clock window opens, the mark lands and the estimate pins. The plume burns under Doesn't prevent fires. The line from the truck stops short of the responder badge as Can share pins. The visor calendar takes a check pass and is attributed. The blank record slides onto the tailgate and pulses its fields. The plan folder arrives, Expected January 2027 pins, and the composite closes the film.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what the camera sees and ends on the alert landed with the crew, the line to responders open and the plan awaiting approval, with no implied well fire.
